senses.gloss:
शैल शैल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शिला), craggy,
rocky, stony, mountainous; (अस्), m. a rock, crag,
mountain, hill; a dike; (अम्), n. benzoin or storax;
bitumen; a sort of collyrium, = रसाञ्जन, तार्-
क्ष्य-शैल; (ई), f., see below.
—शैल-कटक,
अस्, m. the brow of a hill, slope of a mountain.
—शैल-कुञ्ज, अस्, m. a mountain-thicket.
—शैल-
गन्ध, अम्, n. a kind of sandal (= शावर-चन्-
दन).
—शैल-गर्भाह्वा (˚भ-आह्˚), f. a kind
of medicinal substance (= शिला-वल्का).
—शैल-ज,
अस्, आ, अम्, produced in or on mountains or rocks,
&c.; (आ), f. epithet of Durgā; a kind of plant, =
सिंह-पिप्पली; another plant, = गज-पिप्पली;
(अम्), n. a fragrant resinous substance, benzoin or
storax; bitumen.
—शैल-जन, अस्, m. one who
inhabits mountains, a mountaineer.
—शैल-तस्, ind.
from a mountain; than a mountain.
—शैल-धन्-
[]
वन्, आ, m. ‘rock-bowed,’ epithet of Śiva.
—शैल-
धर, अस्, m. ‘mountain-holder,’ epithet of Kṛṣṇa,
(see गो-वर्धन.)
—शैल-निर्यास, अस्, m. ‘rock-
exudation,’ storax, benzoin.
—शैल-पति, इस्, m.
‘mountain-lord,’ the Himālaya mountain.
—शैल-
पत्त्र, अस्, m. the Vilva tree.
—शैल-पुत्री, f. a
proper N.
—शैल-भित्ति, इस्, f. a stone-cutter's chisel
or axe, an instrument for dividing or cutting stones.
—शैल-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, rocky, made of stone,
consisting of stones.
—शैल-रन्ध्र, अम्, n.
‘rocky hollow,’ a cavern, cave.
—शैल-राज, अस्,
m. ‘king of mountains,’ epithet of the Himālaya;
of Indra-kīla.
—शैलराज-सुता, f. ‘daughter of
Himālaya,’ epithet of Durgā.
—शैल-रुग्ण, अस्, आ,
अम्, crushed by mountains.
—शैल-वनोपपन्न
(˚न-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, possessed of mountains and
woods.
—शैल-वल्कला, f. a kind of medicinal
substance (= शिला-वल्का).
—शैल-वास, अस्, m. a
mountain-habitation.
—शैल-वीज, अस्, m. ‘having
stony seeds,’ the marking-nut plant.
—शैल-शिख-
र, अम्, n. the crest or peak of a mountain.
—शैल-
शिखा, f. ‘mountain-top,’ a kind of metre.
—शैल-
शिविर, अम्, n. ‘rock-camp,’ the ocean.
—शैल-
शृङ्ग, अम्, n. a mountain-peak.
—शैल-सार, अस्,
आ, अम्, having the strength of a mountain, as strong
as a mountain, hard, firm as a rock.
—शैल-सुता,
f. ‘daughter of the mountain,’ epithet of Umā or
Pārvatī, daughter of Himavat.
—शैलसुता-चरण-
राग-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, produced by the colour of
the feet of Pārvatī.
—शैलांश or शैलांश-
देश (˚ल-अं˚), अस्, m., N. of a country.
—शैला-
ख्य (˚ल-आख्˚), अम्, n. a fragrant resinous sub-
stance; benzoin.
—शैलाग्र (˚ल-अग्˚), अम्, n. the
peak of a mountain.
—शैलाङ्ग or शैलाङ्ग-देश
(˚ल-अङ्˚), अस्, m., N. of a country.
—शैला-ज, अम्,
n. (शैला for शैल), = शैल-ज, q. v.
—शैलाट (˚ल-
अट), अस्, m. a mountaineer, savage, barbarian; a
lion; (an attendant on) an idol; crystal.
—शै-
लाधिप (˚ल-अध्˚), अस्, m. ‘king of mountains,’
epithet of the Himālaya.
—शैलेन्द्र (˚ल-इन्˚), अस्,
m. ‘prince of mountains,’ epithet of the Himālaya.
—शैलेन्द्र-स्थ, अस्, m. the Bhojpatra tree (=
भूर्ज).
—शैलेश-लिङ्ग, अम्, n., N. of a Liṅga.
—शैलोदा (˚ल-उद्˚), f., N. of a river.
—शैलोद्-
भवा (˚ल-उद्˚), f. a kind of plant, a small species
of पाषाण-भेदिन्.
शैलक, अम्, n. benzoin or storax; bitumen.

शैलादि, इस्, m., N. of Nandin (the attendant
of Śiva).
शैलावत्य, अस्, m. a proper N.

शैली, f. a short explanatory rule, concise explana-
tion of a grammatical aphorism; a special or parti-
cular interpretation.

शैलेय, अस्, ई, अम्, produced in the mountains,
&c., mountainous; produced from rocks; rocky,
stony, mountain-like, hard; (अम्), n. a fragrant
resin; benzoin or storax; a vegetable perfume (=
मुरा); a kind of plant (= ताल-पर्णी); rock-salt;
(अस्), m. a lion; a bee; (ई), f., N. of Pārvatī.
—शैलेय-गन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, fragrant with benzoin
or with the bituminous exudation of rocks.
शैलेयिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to benzoin or storax.

शैल्य, अस्, -ली, अम्, rocky, stony, hard; (अम्),
n. rockiness, stoniness, hardness.
शैलाद शैलाद, अस्, m. (fr. शिलाद), a proper N.

शैलाल शैलाल, अम्, n. (fr. शिलालि, q. v.),
the principles of acting, (this word seems to have
been formed to account for the derivation of शैला-
लिन् below.)

शैलालि, इस्, m. a proper N., (Śatapatha-Br. XIII.
5, 3, 3.)

शैलालिन्, ई, m. an actor, dancer; (इनस्), m. pl.,
N. of a school.
—शैलालि-ब्राह्मण, अम्, n., N.
of a Brāhmaṇa.

शैलिक्य शैलिक्य, अस्, m. (etymology doubt-
ful), an impostor, hypocrite, pretended devotee (=
सर्वलिङ्गिन्).

शैलूष शैलूष, अस्, m. (said to be fr. शि-
[]
लूष, q. v.), an actor, public dancer, tumbler, &c.;
a band-master, leader of a band, one who beats time
at a concert (= ताल-धारक); a rogue, cheat; the
Vilva tree, Ægle Marmelos.

शैलूषि, इस्, m. a patronymic of the Vedic Ṛṣi
Kulmala-barhiṣa.

शैलूषिक, अस्, m. one who follows the profession
of an actor, &c. (= नट-वृत्त्य्-अन्वेषिन्).

शैलूषिकी, f. a woman of the actor caste, an
actress.
